title: FIFO Module
prompt: Build a bounded queue: private storage, public `void q_clear(void)`, `int q_push(int v)` (0 when full, capacity 8), `int q_pop(int *out)` (0 when empty or out==NULL, else 1 and the OLDEST value).

tests.name: fifo order
full rejected
null out
tests.hint: NULL out must be rejected safely.
